gen-gf-goldman-gf-montagu-slab: Goldman spreads its letters wide, with round forms like open parentheses and a lowercase that nearly crowds the capitals. Montagu Slab is the text serif underneath, with robust downstrokes and slender turns that give it real texture.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Wide, bold, commanding: Goldman stretches its letters out with generous clearance between them. Noto Serif Hentaigana sets a quieter, tall-bodied texture beneath.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-ovo: Commanding Goldman spreads wide, its round forms curving like open parentheses. Ovo follows in a gently modulated stroke, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders that make a long page feel settled.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded, its lowercase tall in every letter. Grandstander is the one for bold, expressive display, flat in line weight, while the text serif handles the steady work of the paragraph.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-erode: Erode reads like an editorial page, with a tall middle band and a gentle ebb and flow in its stroke weight. Grandstander shouts, while the classic serif settles in.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-hoover: Grandstander draws every line with no hairlines and no shadows at all. It carries the bold, expressive display voice, while Hoover, a text serif with compressed ascenders, does the quieter work.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab reads dignified, with almost no gap between its x-height and caps. Make Grandstander small and its bold, joined-up strokes lose their punch, while a large serif body would crowd the page.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-domine: Domine reads refined and dignified, its compact ascenders sitting over tall lowercase. And Grandstander, drawn in one plain thread, loses its swagger if made small, just as a large classic serif body would feel heavy.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-esteban: Bold and bouncy up top. Esteban follows in a serif whose thin parts barely slim down, so a long passage flows with a wide-open e and oversized lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-faustina: Ruler-straight and playful, Grandstander holds every curve at the same line width. Faustina, a text serif with open-jawed c shapes and gently thinning bowls, reads like a long, assured paragraph.
